notes:
- **Dictation can use a different tone in each app.** With **Enhance with AI** on, mail programs start **Formal**, chat programs **Casual**, and terminals, code editors and AI chat boxes **Raw**: exactly what you said, with no language model at all. In a browser the site in the tab decides (Gmail, Slack, ChatGPT and more); the tab's title is read on your PC for that and never saved or sent. Add your own tones with a name and instructions, and set a tone for any app under **Settings › Dictation › Tones**. See [Tones](/docs/transcribe/#tones).
- **The pill shows the tone for a moment when you start, and you can change it there.** Click the tone to list them; A9 Voice remembers your pick for that app and uses it for this dictation too. History keeps the name of the tone each dictation used.
- **Nothing changes by itself.** With Enhance off, every app is Raw and nothing goes to a language model, as before. If Enhance was already on, your style and custom instructions became your default tone (**My style**) and every app keeps it until you turn on **Suggested tones for mail, chat and terminals**.
